$comment: Default provider catalogue for free-llm. Every entry is DISABLED until you run
`free-llm add <id>`. limitConfidence records how much to trust each figure:
verified   - confirmed against official docs on researchedOn
unverified - published somewhere but not confirmed; probe to correct
assumed    - NOT published anywhere, so a deliberately CONSERVATIVE floor is
used. Never treat an unknown limit as unlimited; under-using a
free tier is recoverable, exceeding it gets the key banned.
Run `free-llm probe <id>` to replace any of these with a measured value.
Cerebras is excluded: its widely cited 1M-tokens/day free tier was discontinued
and is now a $5 credit trial requiring a payment method.

providers.label: GroqCloud
providers.note: org-level limits; daily reset ~midnight UTC (unverified); retry-after headers on 429

providers.label: NVIDIA NIM
providers.note: prototyping-only terms, no SLA, models rotate

providers.label: OpenRouter
providers.note: lower routing priority on free variants; client must retry on 429

providers.label: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.note: neuron budget shared across models/task types; hard daily stop

providers.label: GitHub Models
providers.note: prototyping-only ToS; public preview; low concurrency; 8K/4K per-request token caps

providers.label: Google AI Studio
providers.note: free-tier data used for training (except EEA/UK/CH); per-project quota

providers.label: Z.AI / Zhipu GLM
providers.note: long-context (>8K) Flash requests throttled to 1% concurrency under load; China vs international account split; China data residency

providers.label: ModelScope
providers.note: best-effort community capacity; separate China/international accounts; daily reset time undocumented

providers.label: SambaNova Cloud
providers.note: reportedly unavailable in EU/UK/CH (unverified); very low 20 RPD cap

providers.label: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.note: EU-hosted; cold starts reported; authenticated tier needs a Public Cloud project
